title: Benchmarking Protein Structure Tokenizers as Generation Targets for Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.32168v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discrete structure tokenizers are the standard way to give a language model access to protein three-dimensional structure, yet they are selected on how accurately they can be read, their reconstruction fidelity, while the property that governs generation is how well a model can write them. We measure this property, writability, directly: holding the base model, data, recipe and compute fixed, we swap only the tokenizer and train the same 9B model to emit structure tokens residue by residue, over eight tokenizers, four compute budgets and three evaluation sets (96 cells). At 2B tokens final writability runs from TM 0.662 down to 0.378 under identical conditions, with five of the eight arms clearing the TM 0.5 mark at which a fold is usually called correct and three falling short of it. translated_title: 蛋白质结构分词器作为语言模型生成目标的基准测试
translated_abstract: 离散结构分词器是让语言模型获取蛋白质三维结构的标准方式，然而目前选择分词器的依据是其“可读性”（即重建保真度），而真正决定生成效果的性质却是模型“写出”这些token的能力。我们直接测量了这一性质（可写性）：在保持基础模型、数据、训练方案和计算资源完全一致的情况下，仅更换分词器，训练同一个9B模型逐残基生成结构token，覆盖八种分词器、四个计算预算和三个评估集（共96个组合）。在20亿token时，相同条件下最终可写性从TM 0.662到0.378不等，八个分支中有五个超过TM 0.5（通常认为达到该值即折叠结构判定为正确），三个未达标。码本大小和重建上限均无法解释各分支的表现差异；表现最好和最差的分支都使用了8192个码字。真正能解释这一差异的是……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次提出以“可写性”而非传统的重建保真度来评测蛋白质结构分词器，通过固定9B模型和训练配置、仅更换分词器的96组对照实验，发现不同分词器的生成效果差异巨大（TM 0.378–0.662），且与码本大小和重建上限无关。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "writability" as the key metric for benchmarking protein structure tokenizers as generation targets, showing through 96 controlled experiments swapping tokenizers in a fixed 9B language model that generation quality varies widely (TM 0.378–0.662) and is unexplained by codebook size or reconstruction fidelity.
